headline: Fed's Cook Warns Interest Rates Must Rise Further to Control Inflation
summary: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook said US interest rates are not high enough and urgent rate increases are necessary to curb persistent inflation. She warned that delaying action could force steeper rate hikes later.
why: The Federal Reserve sets central banking policy for the United States, influencing global borrowing costs and liquidity.

impacts.name: US Federal Funds Rate
impacts.why: Federal Reserve guidance indicated benchmark borrowing rates must rise to tackle inflation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Hawkish remarks from Fed Governor Cook signaled monetary policy tightening would persist, dampening investor risk appetite.
